title: 钟表匠的信
summary: A clock repairer discovers a decades-old letter hidden inside a clock and must decide whether to deliver it, risking upheaval in a family.
topic: A letter hidden inside a repaired clock

blocks.hanzi: 老陈经营一家钟表修理店已有四十年。他的手艺精湛，尤其擅长修复那些被遗忘的古董钟。
blocks.translation: Old Chen has been running a clock and watch repair shop for forty years. His craftsmanship is exquisite, and he is especially good at restoring those forgotten antique clocks.
blocks.pinyin: Lǎo Chén jīngyíng yī jiā zhōngbiǎo xiūlǐ diàn yǐ yǒu sìshí nián. Tā de shǒuyì jīngzhàn, yóuqí shàncháng xiūfù nàxiē bèi yíwàng de gǔdǒng zhōng.

blocks.hanzi: 师傅，这个老座钟是我爷爷留下的。它停了二十年，您看还能修好吗？
blocks.translation: Master, this old pendulum clock was left by my grandfather. It has stopped for twenty years, do you think it can still be repaired?
blocks.pinyin: shīfu, zhège lǎo zuòzhōng shì wǒ yéye liúxià de. tā tíng le èrshí nián, nín kàn hái néng xiūhǎo ma?

blocks.hanzi: 我试试。这种德国制的老钟，零件不好找，但并非不可能。
blocks.translation: I'll give it a try. This old German-made clock, spare parts are hard to find, but not impossible.
blocks.pinyin: wǒ shì shì. zhè zhǒng dé guó zhì de lǎo zhōng, líng jiàn bù hǎo zhǎo, dàn bìng fēi bù kě néng.

blocks.hanzi: 顾客走后，老陈打开钟的后盖，准备清理机芯。忽然，他指尖触到一张泛黄的纸片。
blocks.translation: After the customer left, Old Chen opened the back cover of the clock and prepared to clean the movement. Suddenly, his fingertip touched a yellowed piece of paper.
blocks.pinyin: gù kè zǒu hòu, lǎo chén dǎ kāi zhōng de hòu gài, zhǔn bèi qīng lǐ jī xīn. hū rán, tā zhǐ jiān chù dào yī zhāng fàn huáng de zhǐ piàn.

blocks.hanzi: 他小心翼翼地取出纸片，发现是一封信，字迹工整，但墨水已经褪色。
blocks.translation: He carefully took out a piece of paper and found it was a letter. The handwriting was neat, but the ink had faded.
blocks.pinyin: tā xiǎoxīnyìyì de qǔchū zhǐpiàn, fāxiàn shì yīfēng xìn, zìjì gōngzhěng, dàn mòshuǐ yǐjīng tuìsè

blocks.hanzi: 这信……藏在钟里几十年了吧。
blocks.translation: This letter... has been hidden in the clock for decades, hasn't it?
blocks.pinyin: zhè xìn ... cáng zài zhōng lǐ jǐ shí nián le ba.

blocks.hanzi: 信上写着：“致我儿：当你读到这封信时，我已不在人世。请原谅我的不辞而别，我从未停止爱你。”落款日期是一九七五年。
blocks.translation: The letter says: “To my son: When you read this letter, I am no longer in this world. Please forgive me for leaving without saying goodbye; I have never stopped loving you.” The signature is dated 1975.
blocks.pinyin: Xìn shàng xiě zhe: “Zhì wǒ ér: Dāng nǐ dú dào zhè fēng xìn shí, wǒ yǐ bù zài rénshì. Qǐng yuánliàng wǒ de bùcí'érbié, wǒ cóngwèi tíngzhǐ ài nǐ.” Luòkuǎn rìqī shì yī jiǔ qī wǔ nián.

blocks.hanzi: 老陈沉思良久。这显然是那位顾客的爷爷留下的信，但信中提到的是“我儿”，看来这位爷爷当年抛下了自己的孩子。
blocks.translation: Old Chen pondered for a long time. This was clearly the letter left by that customer's grandfather, but in the letter it mentioned 'my child'; it seems that this grandfather had abandoned his own child back then.
blocks.pinyin: Lǎo Chén chénsī liángjiǔ. Zhè xiǎnrán shì nà wèi gùkè de yéye liúxià de xìn, dàn xìn zhōng tídào de shì “wǒ ér”, kànlái zhè wèi yéye dāngnián pāoxià le zìjǐ de háizi.

blocks.hanzi: 若把信交给小王，他父亲会怎么想？或许这会揭开旧伤疤。
blocks.translation: If we give the letter to Xiao Wang, what would his father think? Perhaps this will reopen old wounds.
blocks.pinyin: ruò bǎ xìn jiāogěi xiǎowáng, tā fùqīn huì zěnme xiǎng? huòxǔ zhè huì jiēkāi jiù shāngbā.

blocks.hanzi: 老陈辗转难眠。第二天，他决定先联系小王的父亲——也就是那位被父亲抛弃的儿子。
blocks.translation: Old Chen tossed and turned, unable to sleep. The next day, he decided to first contact Xiao Wang's father—that is, the son who was abandoned by his father.
blocks.pinyin: Lǎo Chén zhǎnzhuǎn nánmián. Dì'èr tiān, tā juédìng xiān liánxì Xiǎo Wáng de fùqīn——yě jiùshì nà wèi bèi fùqīn pāoqì de érzi.

blocks.hanzi: 喂，请问是王先生吗？我是修钟表的老陈。您儿子拿来的老钟里，我找到了一封信。
blocks.translation: Hello, is this Mr. Wang? I'm Old Chen, the clock repairman. In the old clock your son brought, I found a letter.
blocks.pinyin: wèi, qǐngwèn shì Wáng xiānsheng ma? Wǒ shì xiū zhōngbiǎo de lǎo Chén. Nín érzi nálái de lǎo zhōng lǐ, wǒ zhǎodào le yī fēng xìn.

blocks.hanzi: 哦？什么信？我是他母亲，他父亲已经去世多年了。
blocks.translation: Oh? What letter? I am his mother, and his father passed away many years ago.
blocks.pinyin: ò？shénme xìn？wǒ shì tā mǔqīn，tā fùqīn yǐjīng qùshì duōnián le。

blocks.hanzi: 老陈愣住了。接电话的竟是小王的奶奶。他意识到，这封信或许正是她丈夫留下的。
blocks.translation: Old Chen was stunned. The person who answered the phone turned out to be Xiao Wang's grandmother. He realized that this letter might have been left behind by her husband.
blocks.pinyin: lǎo chén lèng zhù le. jiē diàn huà de jìng shì xiǎo wáng de nǎi nai. tā yì shí dào, zhè fēng xìn huò xǔ zhèng shì tā zhàng fu liú xià de.

blocks.hanzi: 李奶奶，这封信是您丈夫写的，藏在一个老钟里。信上说，他很后悔离开你们。
blocks.translation: Grandma Li, this letter was written by your husband, hidden inside an old clock. The letter says that he very much regrets leaving you.
blocks.pinyin: Lǐ nǎi nai, zhè fēng xìn shì nín zhàngfu xiě de, cáng zài yī gè lǎo zhōng lǐ. Xìn shàng shuō, tā hěn hòuhuǐ líkāi nǐmen.

blocks.hanzi: （沉默片刻）他走了四十年，我一直以为他有了新家。原来……他心里还有我们。
blocks.translation: (After a moment of silence) He left forty years ago. I always thought he had a new family. It turns out... he still has us in his heart.
blocks.pinyin: (chénmò piànkè) tā zǒu le sìshí nián, wǒ yīzhí yǐwéi tā yǒu le xīn jiā. yuánlái…… tā xīnlǐ hái yǒu wǒmen.

blocks.hanzi: 老陈将信亲自送到李奶奶手中。她读完后泪流满面，却露出释然的微笑。
blocks.translation: Old Chen delivered the letter to Grandma Li in person. After reading it, she burst into tears, yet smiled with relief.
blocks.pinyin: Lǎo Chén jiāng xìn qīnzì sòngdào Lǐ nǎinai shǒuzhōng. Tā dú wán hòu lèiliúmǎnmiàn, què lùchū shìrán de wéixiào.

blocks.hanzi: 谢谢你，老陈。这封信虽然迟了这么多年，但它让我们知道，他从未真正离开。
blocks.translation: Thank you, Lao Chen. This letter, though many years late, lets us know that he never truly left.
blocks.pinyin: xiè xie nǐ, lǎo chén. zhè fēng xìn suī rán chí le zhè me duō nián, dàn tā ràng wǒ men zhī dào, tā cóng wèi zhēn zhèng lí kāi.

blocks.hanzi: 那天晚上，老陈坐在店里，看着墙上滴答作响的钟表。他明白，有些秘密虽然尘封已久，但揭开时，也能带来温暖。
blocks.translation: That evening, Old Chen sat in the shop, looking at the ticking clock on the wall. He understood that although some secrets had been dust-covered for a long time, when revealed, they could also bring warmth.
blocks.pinyin: Nà tiān wǎnshàng, Lǎo Chén zuò zài diàn lǐ, kànzhe qiáng shàng dīdā zuòxiǎng de zhōngbiǎo. Tā míngbai, yǒuxiē mìmì suīrán chénfēng yǐjiǔ, dàn jiēkāi shí, yě néng dàilái wēnnuǎn.

blocks.hanzi: 他继续修理着那只老钟，仿佛时间在它身上留下了最珍贵的痕迹。
blocks.translation: He continued repairing the old clock, as though time had left its most precious traces upon it.
blocks.pinyin: tā jìxù xiūlǐ zhe nà zhī lǎo zhōng ， fǎngfú shíjiān zài tā shēnshang liúxià le zuì zhēnguì de hénjì 。
